Business · Positioning · Content · Systems

Why this matters

Attention is cheap.
Trust is the advantage.

Being seen is not the same as being trusted. We build content that helps attention turn into something that lasts: people who share, return and reach out.

The attention economy

  • Rewards volume, hooks and trends
  • Measured in views
  • Can be bought
  • Fades when you stop posting

The trust economy

  • Rewards depth, consistency and credibility
  • Measured in shares, saves and enquiries
  • Has to be earned
  • Compounds over time

That is why we look beyond reach. We pay attention to trust signals: content people pass on, organic growth, and enquiries that arrive because the work resonates.

Our belief
Content should start with the business, not the algorithm. Before we decide what to publish, we need to understand what matters, who it serves, and why anyone should care.

Questions people usually ask

Before we talk.

You don't need to have everything figured out. These are the questions we usually start with.

1. What does CanvasLab actually do?

We help experts and brands make their expertise clear and useful through business positioning, content strategy, content production and the systems that keep content improving. We start by understanding the business, then decide what content should do.

2. Who is CanvasLab a good fit for?

We work with expertise-led businesses, brands and people who have something meaningful to teach or explain. That can include fintech, mental health, clinics, subject-matter experts, academicians and self-help platforms. The key is having real expertise to communicate, not simply wanting to post more.

3. Do we need a strategy before working with you?

No. Many clients start with discovery and positioning because it helps us understand the business, audience and market before recommending the right scope. If you already have a clear strategy and mainly need production, we can discuss that too.

4. Do you only produce podcasts?

No. Podcasts and interview-style video are part of our production work, but we also offer discovery, positioning, content strategy and ongoing partnership. We choose the format based on the business, the audience and what the content needs to achieve.

5. What will we get if we work with CanvasLab?

It depends on the scope. Work may include a positioning statement, core messaging and point of view; a content roadmap; podcasts, interview-led videos and short-form content; or a review process with KPIs and iteration. We'll define the deliverables before work begins.

6. Our team isn't comfortable on camera. Can you help?

Yes. Our interview-led approach is designed to feel more like a conversation than a scripted presentation. We shape the questions and recording process around the people involved, so they can explain what they know in a natural way.

7. How do you measure whether the content is working?

Views matter, but they don't tell the whole story. We look at signals of trust and relevance too, such as shares, saves, organic audience growth and enquiries. The measures depend on the goal we agree on at the start.

8. Do we need to run paid ads to get results?

Paid promotion can support a campaign, but it isn't a requirement for every engagement. CanvasLab focuses on understanding the business and building content that earns attention and trust. We'll discuss paid distribution if it fits your goals and scope.

9. How do we get started, and how long will it take?

Start by telling us about your business, who you serve and what you want your content to achieve. We'll have an initial conversation, understand the need and discuss a suitable scope and timeline. Timing depends on the work involved, so we'll confirm it before starting.

10. How much does it cost, and can we see examples of your work?

Pricing depends on the scope, deliverables and level of support required, so we don't quote a one-size-fits-all package here. We keep case-study summaries on the website concise and can share more detailed case-study material when you contact us.
